title: HP Inc. (HPQ) Ex-Dividend Date Scheduled for June 12, 2018
text:
HP Inc. (HPQ) Ex-Dividend Date Scheduled for June 12, 2018 June 11, 2018, 09:00:06 AM
HP Inc. ( HPQ ) will begin trading ex-dividend on June 12, 2018. A cash dividend payment of $0.139 per share is scheduled to be paid on July 05, 2018. Shareholders who purchased HPQ prior to the ex-dividend date are eligible for the cash dividend payment. This marks the 3rd quarter that HPQ has paid the same dividend. At the current stock price of $23.71, the dividend yield is 2.35%.
The previous trading day's last sale of HPQ was $23.71, representing a -4.2% decrease from the 52 week high of $24.75 and a 38.65% increase over the 52 week low of $17.10.
HPQ is a part of the Technology sector, which includes companies such as Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) and International Business Machines Corporation ( IBM ). HPQ's current earnings per share, an indicator of a company's profitability, is $2.6. Zacks Investment Research reports HPQ's forecasted earnings growth in 2018 as 21.21%, compared to an industry average of 36.4%.
For more information on the declaration, record and payment dates, visit the HPQ Dividend History page. Our Dividend Calendar has the full list of stocks that have an ex-dividend today.
Interested in gaining exposure to HPQ through an Exchange Traded Fund [ETF]? The following ETF(s) have HPQ as a top-10 holding: SPDR Russell 1000 Yield Focus ETF ( ONEY ) SPDR S&P Technology Hardware ETF ( XTH ).
The top-performing ETF of this group is XTH with an increase of 3.45% over the last 100 days. ONEY has the highest percent weighting of HPQ at 3.05%.
